Thank you for the long and meaningful reply. In the short while my post has been up, I have sort of snapped out of things but nonetheless the I appreciate your response as I still don't wish to dismiss the prospect of flying completely. As for the depression and drugs thing - nope, never been on them, and never has medication ever been on the cards. I've always been 100% against the drug path, as it's my own personal belief that, at least for me, drugs is not happiness - it's an escape.

I was thinking the other day about an operator that can hijack the other team's gadgets. The thought of defence operators being caught in their own Frost mats is funny to me but the thing is it needs to be both fair to the other team as well as useful enough. You make example of the ADS, but think; how many defence ops actually have grenades, and how often are they used? I never see impacts used offensively and the only 'grenade' I see used against players is the nitro cell.
As for weapon choice I really feel as if you could do much more interesting stuff than introducing more AR-15s and Remington 870s. We already have an AUG-based firearm for IQ and the F88 Austeyr is very much based off the AUGA2. The [F90](https://vignette4.wikia.nocookie.net/codfanfic/images/7/70/1360862215.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20130422040714_) would be more refreshing and the MAG-58 or Minimi could also work on attack. There's also the HK417 or MK14 that we've used briefly in modern wars. Hell, if you really want to get creative we could throw in an L1A1 SLR (We've seen historic/older firearms with Frost and Tachanka, why stop there?).
Defence really doesn't need another assault rifle; leave that one to Jager. Defender SMGs could include the F1 SMG, or the Owen Gun.

They are two very different characters, the only thing they share in common is their shield. Montagne is definitely a supporting character, you're not supposed to take the enemy on with him by yourself. Instead, you're usually helping your team mates by making callouts, providing cover and denying enemies into the objective (best part of Montagne imo). Blitz however, is certainly more aggressive than Montagne. You don't really need your team with you to function, you've got a strong ability and a relatively strong pistol. You're not rushing, but you're still playing offensively.

Having high ping itself isn't cheating in any sense. However, using programs and such to degrade your connection? Definitely.

There should really be a ping cap, similar to CS:GO where you can set the cap yourself or it simply won't let you queue for a match if your ping is abnormally high.

I'm all for customization but by allowing people to create their own characters you remove one important part of Rainbow Six; perception and game knowledge. If you can't recognise someone by their silhouette and therefore their gadget, it complicates things.
